shortDescription: Manages access-rule objects on Check Point over Web Services API

options.name: action
options.description: a "Accept", "Drop", "Ask", "Inform", "Reject", "User Auth", "Client Auth", "Apply Layer".

options.name: action_settings
options.description: Action settings.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: content
options.description: List of processed file types that this rule applies on. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: content_direction
options.description: On which direction the file types processing is applied. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: content_negate
options.description: True if negate is set for data. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Custom fields.

options.name: destination
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by the name or UID.

options.name: destination_negate
options.description: True if negate is set for destination.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable/Disable the rule.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: inline_layer
options.description: Inline Layer identified by the name or UID. Relevant only if "Action" was set to "Apply Layer".

options.name: install_on
options.description: Which Gateways identified by the name or UID to install the policy on.

options.name: layer
options.description: Layer that the rule belongs to identified by the name or UID.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: position
options.description: Position in the rulebase. The use of values "top" and "bottom" may not be idempotent.

options.name: relative_position
options.description: Position in the rulebase. Use of this field may not be idempotent.

options.name: search_entire_rulebase
options.description: Whether to search the entire rulebase for a rule that's been edited in its relative_position field to make sure there indeed has been a change in its position or the section it might be in.

options.name: service
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by the name or UID.

options.name: service_negate
options.description: True if negate is set for service.

options.name: source
options.description: Collection of Network objects identified by the name or UID.

options.name: source_negate
options.description: True if negate is set for source.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: time
options.description: List of time objects. For example, "Weekend", "Off-Work", "Every-Day".

options.name: track
options.description: Track Settings. Available from R80.10 management version.

options.name: user_check
options.description: User check settings.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: vpn
options.description: Any or All_GwToGw.

options.name: vpn_list
options.description: Communities or Directional.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
